work: Created and published the independently ticketed Sparkassen-Sommerrodelbahn at Stausee Oberwald as a standalone summer toboggan attraction; imported three distinct exact photographs and published its Facebook announcement.
qualification: The operator runs a lakeside recreation area with bathing, camping, boating and minigolf, not a structured amusement park. The toboggan run is a separately ticketed fixed ride. Official editor searches for Oberwald, Callenberg and Sommerrodelbahn am Stausee found no existing Park or StandaloneAttraction; a new standalone was appropriate. The separate Stausee Oberwald candidate in the park inventory was qualified as the recreation venue, not another Park creation.

officialFacts.operatorSeasonStateOn2026-11-15: The operator says it looks forward to the new season; no current ride operating timetable is shown
officialFacts.fareContext: The operator posts separate ride fares and seasonal grounds admission, but no active tariff is published on the fiche while the ride is seasonally closed

sourceLimitations: The displayed ride fares distinguish peak season with grounds admission from off season; the operator gives no confirmed next operating dates. No weekly opening rules or active fare were invented.
The current visit hours for day guests apply to the recreation grounds and were not used as ride hours.
The photographs show the exact installation but may predate current operating conditions.

The manufacturer reference calls the venue Stausee Oberwald; the operator calls the ride Sparkassen-Sommerrodelbahn and gives 375 m descent plus 133 m ascent, rather than a single rounded 370 m value.
